name: Skeleton
description: A placeholder shape shown while content is loading. The shimmer animation communicates that data is on the way. Three variants match common content shapes: text (inline line), circular (avatar/icon), and rectangular (image/card). Marked aria-hidden because it conveys no information to screen readers.

notes: aria-hidden='true' is always applied — the skeleton is purely decorative and must not be announced by screen readers.
Pair with a VisuallyHidden region or an aria-busy='true' container so screen readers know content is loading.
When prefers-reduced-motion is set or animated=false, the shimmer animation is disabled and a plain static background is shown.
The component is not interactive and never receives focus.

variant.description: Shape of the placeholder. text=single line, circular=equal-radius circle, rectangular=block.

width.description: Inline size override. Accepts any CSS value (e.g. '100%', '200px'). Text variant defaults to 100%.

height.description: Block size override. Accepts any CSS value. Circular variant uses width value to keep equal dimensions.

animated.description: Whether to show the shimmer animation. Has no effect when prefers-reduced-motion is set.

className.description: Additional CSS class names applied to the root element.

variants.text: Full-width line at text line-height. Stack multiple for a paragraph placeholder.
variants.circular: Equal-width-and-height circle. Suitable for avatars or icon placeholders.
variants.rectangular: Block rectangle. Suitable for image, card, or banner placeholders.

do: Always set aria-busy='true' on the surrounding container so screen readers know content is loading.
Use the text variant in stacks to simulate paragraph loading.
Set animated=false when you want a static placeholder without motion context.
dont: Do not rely on the Skeleton alone to communicate loading state to screen readers — pair it with aria-busy or a VisuallyHidden announcement.
Do not use a Skeleton when a Spinner is more appropriate (e.g. action in progress vs. content not yet loaded).
Do not apply inline styles — use the width/height props and the className prop.
